title: Harbor clock archive
text: The restored North Harbor clock resumed public operation on 17 May 2018 after a six-year conservation project. The archive identifies Mara Venn as the lead horologist.

title: Botanical greenhouse notes
text: The alpine greenhouse opened in 1994. Its first curator was Elias Noor, and the collection focused on high-altitude medicinal plants.

title: Transit museum catalog
text: The blue tram prototype entered the city museum in 2007. It had previously served as a driver-training vehicle rather than carrying passengers.
